rows.grounds: locative of compound rudra-aṃśa indicating the Rudra division
locative of compound sadana-utsedha indicating the building height
subject or measure referent for the floor or base level
compound expressing measurement by one part

items.question: What floor measure is prescribed when the building height falls in the Rudra division?
premises: The building height can fall in the Rudra division.
The floor level requires a specified proportional measure.
A one-part measure is assigned in this condition.
items.inference: When the house height is in the Rudra division, the floor is measured as one part.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of talam as floor, base, or story level is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: When the height of the house falls in the Rudra division, the floor is to measure one part.
